title: A Federated Learning Data Processing Algorithm Between Homogeneous Smart Workshops
assignee: Nanjing Taliang Numeric Control Tech Co ltd

pse.problem: Existing federated learning methods based on model iterative gradient are sensitive to noise in production data of smart workshops, leading to unreliable data and poor control model performance.
pse.solution_function: The proposed algorithm encrypts and pre-trains models on consumer servers, performs scale unification, wavelet transform, inverse wavelet transform on noisy training data, calculates confidence and income values, computes gradient values, decrypts them back when the loss function converges.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of two consumer servers, each with encryption capabilities for model pre-training. The data processing involves scale unification, wavelet transform, inverse wavelet transform components.
pse.solution_implementation: The algorithm encrypts shared public sample sets, calculates gradient values on consumer servers, and uses tag data to calculate loss values. It utilizes encryption technology for masking and wavelet transform for noise reduction.
pse.effect: The proposed federated learning algorithm reduces noise in data learning, improving the learning effect and reliability of the control model.
